annotations.title: Enrich B2B Company Domains, LinkedIn & Emails

description: Resolve company names, domains, or work emails into verified official websites, LinkedIn company pages, business emails, and DNS deliverability grades. Supply at least one source (inputs, rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); datasetField selects the upstream column, minConfidence sets name-match strictness, and onlyWithEmail or includeUnresolved=false drops misses before billing. Streams in 50-item chunks (~10-45s per 100 companies) with per-company error isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, optional webhookUrl delivery, and $2.50/1K enriched billing ($0 for parked, unresolved, or filtered skips). Use for B2B corporate enrichment; do not use for creator link-in-bio pages (use enrich_creator_bio_leads instead).

crmExportPreset.description: Optional flat CRM column mapping preset while preserving standard fields.

datasetField.description: Optional explicit field name to read from datasetId/sourceRunId items when chaining.

datasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL (auto-detects website, domain, companyName, name, or email fields).

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

enrichContactPages.description: Follow up to 2 internal /contact or /about pages when the homepage lacks emails or LinkedIn.

includeUnresolved.description: Include unresolved/not_found rows in the dataset for auditability (always $0 cost).

inputs.description: Up to 2,000 company names, domains, URLs, or work emails, e.g. ["Stripe", "Linear", "apify.com"]. Optional when rawCsvOrUrls, datasetId, or sourceRunId is provided.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for accepting company-name-to-domain matches.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only companies where at least 1 verified email is found ($0 otherwise).

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV/TSV rows or newline-separated company names, domains, URLs, or work emails.

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTPS webhook URL notified with run metrics and top leads on completion.

name: enrich_b2b_company_leads

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

inboxType.description: Inbox risk classification (b2b_direct, general, cs_ticket_queue, or none).

input.description: Original company name, domain, or email input.
